messages.subject: Strange Log2fc values
parts:
Hi,

I noticed an outlier log2fc value for a protein in the finished report. I think I have traced it back to a very large imputed abundance for a peptide. 

> select(quantdata$FeatureLevelData %>% filter(PROTEIN == "P21912"), GROUP, RUN , censored, INTENSITY, ABUNDANCE, newABUNDANCE, predicted)
   GROUP RUN censored INTENSITY ABUNDANCE newABUNDANCE predicted
1      A   1    FALSE  12436600  23.46295     23.46295        NA
2      A   2    FALSE  17163400  24.13429     24.13429        NA
3      B   3     TRUE        NA        NA    296.37264  296.3726

Does anyone know why this is happening and/or what I can do to prevent this in the future? There are a total of three peptides with high imputed values. My dataProcess options are 

  logTrans = 2,
  normalization = 'equalizeMedians',
  summaryMethod = 'TMP',
  MBimpute = TRUE,
  censoredInt='NA',
  maxQuantileforCensored = 0.999

Thank you,
-Chris
